name: japan-map-deck
description: Scripts and data to generate the notes and map images for the Japan Map Anki deck.

scripts.fetch: node scripts/fetch-all.js && node scripts/fetch-flags.js && npm run pronunciation
scripts.fetch:refresh: node scripts/fetch-all.js --refresh && node scripts/fetch-flags.js --refresh && npm run pronunciation:refresh
scripts.build: npm run records && npm run render && npm run notes
scripts.apkg: npm run apkg:build && npm run apkg:describe
